name: StatCurves
src_typeComment: Common gameplay-balancing formulas as pure functions — the kind of curve every RPG/looter needs and usually reinvents slightly differently each time.

src_members.sig: public static float ExperienceForLevel(int level, float baseXP = 100f, float growthRate = 1.15f)
src_members.name: ExperienceForLevel
src_members.comment: Total XP required to REACH a given level (level 1 = 0 XP). Growth compounds each level by growthRate.

src_members.sig: public static float LinearFalloff(float distance, float minDistance, float maxDistance, float fullDamage)
src_members.name: LinearFalloff
src_members.comment: Linear falloff: full damage at/inside minDistance, zero damage at/beyond maxDistance.

src_members.sig: public static float SmoothFalloff(float distance, float minDistance, float maxDistance, float fullDamage)
src_members.name: SmoothFalloff
src_members.comment: Smoothed (ease-out) falloff — damage drops off gently near minDistance and steeply near maxDistance, reading as more "natural" than a straight linear ramp.
